$description: The photos in the home page's 'Come and see it' strip, in order. slot is a media slot (gallery/*); shape is arch, circle or frame (an arch suits an upright photo, a circle a square one). caption is optional: leave it out for a picture that carries its own words (the MHT-CET poster). A photo whose file is not supplied yet is left out. Captions are a first draft for D-SAP to confirm against who is in each photo.
